CHECK BURST CS-asm-fg-v4-fog — assemble the cliffside FOREGROUND canvas from 17 outpainted chunks with minimum-error seams and depth-fade alpha (Matt R-C3-48/54-57, v4.1 geometry). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-fog".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunks_v4.json (paint_order: each chunk's index [cx,cy], origin_px, files; canvas 5376×4096; chunk 1536×1024; step 1280×768); painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>/chunk_<cx>_<cy>.png (flat #00ff00 = void) — where a re-drive directory CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>-r1/ exists use it instead of the original; per-chunk masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunk_<cx>_<cy>_mask.png; the full-canvas DEPTH map /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_depth_mm.png (uint16 mm below rim; 65535 = not foreground) and mask /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_mask.png. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files; work in RAM carefully (the canvas is 5376×4096 RGBA).

STEP 1 — per chunk: RGBA = clamp-matte of the painted chunk; alpha restricted to that chunk's mask dilated by 6 px.
STEP 2 — composite in paint_order onto a transparent 5376×4096 canvas. For each chunk, inside every overlap with pixels already placed, cut along a MINIMUM-ERROR path (cost = mean |RGB| between existing and new where both are opaque; where only one is opaque it wins; DP ±1 px per step; vertical path for left overlaps, horizontal for top overlaps; a corner square goes to the lower-cost side), feather ±3 px. Record per seam: chunk pair, path mean cost, p95.
STEP 3 — FOG, NOT TRANSPARENCY (Matt: 'some of the underside of some of the cliffs are transparent' — the old linear alpha fade let the valley show THROUGH the rock). Replace the depth fade with atmospheric fog baked into the foreground, using d = depth mm (0 = top surfaces; 65535 = not foreground):
  (a) FOG COLOUR: F = median RGB of /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-layers/layers/mist.png pixels with alpha ≥ 153, mixed 70/30 with the median RGB of /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-layers/layers/forest_valley.png pixels with alpha ≥ 250. Report F.
  (b) NOISE: one smooth fractal noise field N(x,y) in [0,1] over the canvas (3 octaves, base wavelength ~260 px, deterministic seed 1), used to make the fog irregular.
  (c) HAZE (colour, alpha unchanged): h = smoothstep over d from 6000 mm to 15000 mm, where each pixel's d is first offset by (N−0.5)×3000 mm; RGB = lerp(RGB, F, h).
  (d) FOG EDGE (alpha): a = 1 − smoothstep over d from 15500 mm to 20000 mm, with d offset by (N−0.5)×4000 mm; a = 0 where d = 65535; alpha = alpha × a. So above ~15 m the face is fully OPAQUE (rock turning into fog), and only the fully fog-coloured lower band dissolves, with a ragged cloud-like edge. No pixel may be semi-transparent while still visibly rock: report the max of (1−h) over pixels with 0 < a < 1 (must be ≤ 0.05).
  Re-use STEP 1–2 exactly as specified (same seams); RGB of top surfaces (d = 0) must be byte-identical to a no-fog assembly — report the check.
STEP 4 — write out/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA, straight alpha); out/foreground_preview_1344x1024.png (over #3a3f4a) and out/fog_detail_crops.png (3 full-resolution 640×640 crops where the fog band is widest, over the forest_valley layer colour); out/seams.json (every seam) and out/checks.json (per-chunk IoU vs mask, spill, seam stats summary: count, mean of path means, worst path mean with its pair); out/seam_worst_crops.png (512×512 crops centred on the 4 worst seams, 2×2). out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-fog"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
